About

Lives in Pune, MH 0123456789001234567890.01234567890012345678900123456789001234567890012345678900123456789001234567890012345678900123456789001234567890years oldBorn 4 August 2001 at 16:16

I’m Rajat, a Cloud and DevOps engineer. At amber I look after production infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes, and before that I spent a year at IAMOPS helping clients move to AWS. The parts of the work I like best are the quiet ones: making systems reproducible, making them cheaper, and making sure nobody gets paged at 3 a.m.

Away from work I read, ride a bicycle most weekends and a motorbike when the trip is longer, take photos, and keep a small homelab running at home. This site is served from it.

You can reach me by email, or find me on GitHub and LinkedIn.
